nodes.name: Webhook: /shiftfit/generate
nodes.notes: SECURITY: this webhook now asks callers for a password too (Header Auth), so n8n can't be used as an open door to the protected scheduler service. Use the same credential as the other ShiftFit webhooks. See docs/N8N_ARCHITECTURE.md, Authentication.

nodes.name: Call deterministic scheduler service
nodes.notes: Calls the scheduler service in src/server/handler.ts (POST /generate), which runs the SAME algorithm as src/features/scheduling/scheduler.ts. Do not re-implement scheduling rules in a Code node. Create an n8n Header Auth credential named Authorization with the value Bearer <your secret> (never paste the secret into this JSON). See docs/N8N_ARCHITECTURE.md, Workflow B, Switching it on. Never run against a live service: the service has not been deployed yet.

meta.note: Starting-point template only, not a tested workflow. Server-side scheduler for Workflow B; the service it calls exists in src/server/handler.ts but is not deployed yet. See docs/N8N_ARCHITECTURE.md.
